title: Transported affine Koszul Hom-colimit comparison
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], U a compact open, and E an arbitrary object of D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. With independently chosen derived localizations in morphism universe w for X, every localized open site, and U, let T=O_X[0] [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and R be restriction to the localized site followed by Modules.overEquiv. There are perfect derived objects P_n [def-pc-perfect-complex], augmentations a_n:P_n→Q(T), two-sided inverse restricted augmentations v_n, a diagram D:ℕ→Type w with D(n)=Hom(P_n,E), and a colimit cocone with point Hom(R(Q(T)),R(E)) whose leg at n sends ξ to v_n followed by R(ξ). No chain-level representatives or K-flatness assertions are included.

source.place: Tags 08DC (equation-comparison), 08DD (proposition-represent-cohomology-class-on-open), 08EH (lemma-lift-map, affine setup); source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DD and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08EH

proof.text: Set A=Γ(X,top) and s=X.isoSpec.symm. The inverse image V=s.hom⁻¹(U) is compact by the homeomorphism. PrimeSpectrum.isCompact_isOpen_iff expresses V as the complement of zeroLocus(t) for a finite set t. Enumerate t using Fintype.equivFin; membership in this complement is existence of an element of t not in the prime, so V equals koszulOpen A r f, including t empty. Transfer the global and all localized-open-site derived localizations by exists_scheme_iso_derived_localizations s.

Use the explicit moduleIsoEquivalence s from SchemeIsoDerivedEquivalence and its localized equivalence F. Its forward and inverse localization comparisons he and hi are mapDerivedCategoryFactors. The existing inverse quasi-coherence theorem makes ES=F.inverse(E) a quasi-coherent derived object on Spec(A). Apply exists_spectrum_structure_restriction_comparison to get the chosen derived category on koszulOpen as an open subscheme, the open equivalence G, the unit isomorphism q:F(koszulOpenStructure A) ≅ Q(T), and the full restriction comparison beta:F ⋙ R_X ≅ R_S ⋙ G. Apply affine_perfect_open_represent_cohomology to ES and f.

Put P_n=F(koszulOpenObject A r f n) and a_n=F(koszulOpenUnit n) followed by q.hom. The inverse perfect-transport theorem for s.symm, F.symm and hi proves each P_n perfect. The counit of F identifies F(ES) with E.

The fully proved private transportHomColimit helper handles the remaining categorical transport. Its objectwise bijection l_n sends a spectrum morphism phi to F(phi) followed by the counit; conjugating the original diagram maps by l defines D_X, whose objects are literally Hom(P_n,E). The target bijection t uses full faithfulness of G, beta at the structure and ES objects, and the isomorphisms q and counit. Define v_X,n=R_X(q.inv);beta_T.hom;G(v_n);beta_Pn.inv. Naturality of beta and functoriality prove both inverse identities. The new cocone leg is t(original leg(l_n.inverse(x))); naturality of beta proves it equals v_X,n followed by R_X(x). Types.isColimit_iff_coconeTypesIsColimit translates the original colimit into a type-theoretic cocone. CoconeTypes.IsColimit.precompose along l_n.inverse and IsColimit.of_equiv along t transport the universal property; translate it back to obtain the required IsColimit. This construction introduces no boundedness or nonempty hypothesis.

theorem affine_koszul_section_colimit
    (X : Scheme.{uX}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1.some
    let T := HomologicalComplex.tensorUnit
      (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ (P : ℕ → schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (a : ∀ n : ℕ, P n ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj T),
      (∀ n : ℕ, IsPerfect X (P n)) ∧
      ∃ v : ∀ n : ℕ, R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T) ⟶ R.obj (P n),
        (∀ n : ℕ, R.map (a n) ≫ v n = 𝟙 _) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, v n ≫ R.map (a n) = 𝟙 _) ∧
        ∃ (D : ℕ ⥤ Type wD) (hD : ∀ n : ℕ, D.obj n = (P n ⟶ E.obj)),
        ∃ ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const ℕ).obj
            (R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T) ⟶ R.obj E.obj),
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : P n ⟶ E.obj),
            ι.app n (cast (hD n).symm ξ) = v n ≫ R.map ξ) ∧
          Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk _ ι))
